pyramiding_rule: Absolute prohibition against averaging down or initiating multiple entries within a 3-minute window during high volatility intervals.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require a validated ATR volatility contraction filter and confirmed order book imbalance before ticket execution to avoid wick traps.
profit_harvest_threshold: Aggressively secure partial/full profit when the position reaches +$15.00 to prevent evaporation down to fractional gains.
